notes: Upgraded from reproduced to verified (exact: true, we* + @mizopl, 2026-11-10) via verify_challenge/cert_qutrit_galois_m3_m5.py: projection monotonicity (<0| (x) I^3)|T3>^4 = 3^(-1/2)|T3>^3 (verified symbolically against orbit_state('T3')) applied to the exact Z[omega_3] 173-pivot Galois quotient exclusion chi(T3^3) >= 6. Prior reproduced record (verify_challenge/cert_t3_m4_from_m3.py): The first lower bound on this cell, which previously had none and so still counted as a route to the published exponent at every rank. Puts it at 6 <= chi <= 9. The certificate re-runs the m=3 rank-6 exclusion (Galois descent cutting the search to 45 candidate lines, then exhaustion with every candidate rejected in exact arithmetic over Q(w9)) and applies projection monotonicity: chi(psi (x) phi) >= chi(psi) whenever phi has a nonzero computational amplitude, since I (x) <x| maps a decomposition of psi (x) phi to one of psi with no more terms. Beating the published exponent 1/2 at m=4 needs rank 8, so this does not close the cell as a route; any rank from 6 to 8 at m=4 would beat it, and rank 9 is the product witness that matches it.
